notes.title: Some news ! (this is important stuff)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we didn't gave a lot of news since the publishing of the demo but we continued to work hard on the game !

There is multiple news I'd like to share with you about us and Chaperon.

Bluesky
First of all, we created our Bluesky canal !!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269282/18823ecc8959ff009f0f6a79b14ca707f010eff9.png
You may already know we have a discord server but bluesky will be the place where we will share future work in progress about the game, giving some insights and interacting with you. As I am working on a few stuff at the moment, you can expect to see some news coming soon there.


State of the game
As said previously we continue to make progress on the game. Currently we are working on the achievements, developing the 3rd biome, improving the art on some UIs, adding overall content and planning a few extra features (that may be there on the release, else it will be on a future update).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269282/66bd22266e9794b0aec2ea5d8d38ccb93fd2f347.png
*including the fact that when we published the demo we already add a lot of extra content / features*


Life
On the downside, we cannot continue to work fulltime on the game, we must find a job to live and continue the development on the side. It will push back the release date but we will do our best to deliver the game as fast as we can. We already spent almost 2 years on this project and we are very close to release it so thank you for the waiting and the support !



Thank you for reading this, we will keep you informed on what's coming next so follow us on our social networks <3
